signatures.description: Implement an offline engine for a graph receiving edge insertions, deletions, and queries asking whether two vertices are connected after any prefix rollback; query batches may branch from earlier versions, so a single segment-tree-over-time pass is insufficient. Return a verifiable spanning-forest path or a minimum-size cut certificate for every disconnected query while keeping total work near O((n+q) polylog n), including adversarially nested rollback histories.
